Zoe (mktg): Short plan: 36h paid burst for Aug 3 webinar. Search + retarget, small budget. Need thumbs by 3pm.

Ravi (growth): Budget? regions?

Zoe (mktg): $600/day US only, total $1,800. CPL target <$65, aim 30 regs first 24h.

Lena (creative): I'll deliver two static hero options + a 15s retarget clip. Recommend CTA test: 'Reserve spot' vs 'Join live'.

Oscar (analytics): LP split 70/30 single-step vs two-step. Add reg_uuid hidden field and GA4 event "webinar_reg". UTM template: utm_campaign=aug3_webinar&utm_content={creative}.

Marta (ops): Routing: all regs -> SFDC campaign "Aug3_Webinar_PTF"; attended -> push to SDR queue in HubSpot if watched >=40%. Need prod Zap keys after QA.

Ravi (growth): Campaign skeleton: 3 search ad groups (inference, latency, cost) + 7-day retarget. Bidding: Target CPA $50, frontload 20% in first 3 hours. Swap creative to variant B if CTR <0.5% after 6h.

Zoe (mktg): QA checklist: UTMs, pixel, form validation, Zap test. Upload assets to shared drive and I'll approve.

ads-bot: draft created campaign_id=cmp_aug3_198, url=https://ads.internal/cmp_aug3_198

Lena (creative): Uploading now.

Oscar (analytics): I'll run tracking QA once assets up.

Zoe (mktg): Great — final sign-off by 3pm then schedule go-live tomorrow 9am PT. End thread.
